notes: U3/§9.5: the key is already validly retired at T1, so its later self-signed revocation (recorded T3) is judged with the prior revocation applied: the self-revocation exemption only excludes R's own revocation effect, not earlier revocations of the same key. R is invalid E_KEY_REVOKED and revokes nothing; the original retirement stays effective, so the T4 note is invalid E_KEY_REVOKED too.
